name: smwgraphics-the-mucus-flow-exterior
title: The Mucus Flow - Exterior
description:
A set of grassy terrains and woody supports created for The Mucus Flow, a rom hack by SF - The Dark Warrior for Romhack Races, which itself was based on the Doom WAD of the same name.

Credit is appreciated. Please acknowledge The Dark Warrior and his rom hack as well while you're at it!

The submission also includes an On/Off door and gate that should use custom blocks to properly work.
